Name: Solid Gray Cat Recolor
Author: cinnamorl
Description:
Recolor for the cat pet that makes them solid gray rather than any kind of tabby.
Made for personal use, but thought I'd upload it anyway.

Special credit and huge thanks to my friend Emily for helping me convert the sprite sheet into .xmb format!

Downloads.Description: unzip, then drag and drop the cat.xnb file into the animal sprites folder and replace the existing one. enjoy!

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
